comment: Checks that fail on the committed core, with the reason. compat/run.mjs fails on any failure not listed here and on any listed failure that passes.
jitCoverageComment: Checks per suite whose whole program the JIT compiled (compiledOps = program length). Not compiled today: fctiw, ps_div (nan PsDiv*), ps_sel, ps_rsqrte (pairedmove): those checks are interpreter-only. A change either way fails the run: update the count.

failures.id: ni/multiply smallest normal by 1 minus ulp NI=1
failures.reason: NI flush: hardware flushes a result that is tiny before rounding (rounds up to the smallest normal in IEEE); Dolphin flushes after rounding
